projects.one_line: Ask for a capture in words, such as "show me the UART byte when the FIFO overflows": the agent picks the signals by their RTL names, sets the trigger, rebuilds with a logic analyser, captures on the board and answers in plain words beside the waveform.
projects.title: Debugging in plain English
projects.what_it_will_show: A real capture from the board answering a question asked in words, the waveform it rests on, and the capture handed back to the agent's repair loop.

projects.one_line: A block that sits on the chip beside the IP under test, drives AXI4-Lite and AXI4-Stream traffic from a program loaded at run time, and checks every protocol rule in hardware while the traffic runs.
projects.title: An on-chip AXI traffic generator and protocol checker
projects.what_it_will_show: The checker catching a bug seeded in a peripheral on the board, with the same traffic run in simulation so the first point where the two differ marks the bug.

projects.one_line: How far one chip on the bench runs past its signed-off clock at a measured temperature and voltage, found by stepping the clock at run time; valid for that device only.
projects.title: Margin of one particular chip

projects.one_line: Our own Ethernet processing parses a packet of a made-up market-data format while it is still arriving, a rule set at run time fires, and a reply leaves, with the time from first bit in to first bit out measured as a full distribution. Everything is a mock: no real exchange, market or broker.
projects.title: A mock low-latency trading path

projects.one_line: Banks of logic switched on and off together to step the chip's supply current, with the rail disturbance measured on an oscilloscope.
projects.title: A load stepper for power integrity
